module: Flowgraph node "Rally Super Countdown" (timer icon, tag rally, rallyLoop color). Complete start line system of the rally loop: clock, start position lookup, proximity, placement validation (staging), countdown, reschedule and false start detection. Replaces Rally Clock, Rally Position Getter and Stopped Near Plane. Depends on the rally loop manager: epoch time (getEpochTime), scheduled time of the event eventName (e.g. "SS_start_line"). Sequence: waiting_for_staging_check, then at stagingCheckTime seconds (10 by default) before the start, if the vehicle is placed (in front of the plane within distance m and stopped) → countdown_armed (vehicle frozen if false starts are disabled); otherwise reschedule to the next slot (rm:rescheduleNextSSStart) up to maxReschedules (3). Then countdown_running (voice/visual announcements), launched (0.5 s) then finished. Inputs: flow, reset (pulse), pathData, spName, eventName, vehId, distance, stagingCheckTime, maxReschedules. Outputs: flow, finished, ongoing, waiting, rescheduled, falseStart, maxReschedulesReached (pulses for finished/rescheduled/falseStart/maxReschedulesReached).
notes: Warnings at 60, 30, 15 and 10 s (pacenotes warningSeconds<N>); on the original schedule, 60 s plays commsCheck, 30 s beltsCheck and 10 s precountdown.
False start (signedDistance < 0): pacenote 'falseStart', penalty rm:recordFalseStartPenalty(), unfreeze, the stage starts anyway.
A vehicle that leaves the launch zone during the countdown cancels and reschedules the start.

Countdown skip (onGameplayInteract) possible when the vehicle is placed: sets the loop clock to scheduled - 6 s (COUNTDOWN_SKIP_LEAD_SECONDS) with a 2 s debounce and cuts the side audio. Availability signaled via rm:setCountdownCanSkip.
Thresholds: stopped if speed < 0.08 m/s (hysteresis +0.6 km/h); skip possible below 1 km/h (hysteresis +1 km/h, distance +0.5 m).
Data options: useImgui, useMessages, bigFinishMsg, test (test mode without loop manager), drawDebug.

init.desc: Initializes states, caches, audio flags and data options.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets the node state when the graph starts.

_executionStopped.desc: Stops the timer and unfreezes the vehicle.

reset.desc: Stops the timer, unfreezes the vehicle and sets the outputs to false.

stopTimer.desc: Resets states, scheduling, counters, warnings, flags and audio.

freezeVehicle.desc: Freezes the vehicle via StagedCountdownUtils.freezeVehicle (only once).

unfreezeVehicle.desc: Unfreezes the vehicle if it was frozen by this node.

updateVehicleData.desc: Updates the front position and speed of the tracked vehicle.

updateStartPosition.desc: Looks for the named start position in pathData (with cache) and stores the reason on failure.

updateProximityState.desc: Computes signed distance, stop (with hysteresis), proximity and "staged" state.

isStaged.desc: True if near the plane and stopped.

isInLaunchZone.desc: True if near the plane (stop not required).

hasCrossedStartLine.desc: True if the signed distance is negative (line crossed).

getRallyLoopManager.desc: Returns the rally loop manager (nil in test mode or if the extension is not loaded).

getCurrentEpochTime.desc: Current rally epoch time (test mode: test clock).

getScheduledEventTime.desc: Scheduled time of the event eventName (cached per event and mission).

requestReschedule.desc: Requests postponing the start to the next slot; updates rescheduleCount and the warnings.

returns.desc: True if postponed; false if the maxReschedules limit is reached (maxReschedulesReached flag).

enableRallyManagerPacenoteProcessing.desc: Re-enables the pacenote processing of the rally manager.

randomPauseSecs.desc: Audio pause of random integer duration between min and max.

show.desc: Displays a message via the Message channel if useMessages is active (the flash message is commented out).

shouldStartTimer.desc: True if flow is active, the state is waiting_for_staging_check and no start is scheduled yet.

configureCountdownSettings.desc: Sets duration (6 s/5 announcements with voice, 3 s/3 without), voice, visual and freeze according to the rallyAudioPacenotes/rallyVisualPacenotes settings and false starts.

startTimer.desc: Reads the scheduled time and computes targetStartTime and stagingCheckTime.

updateTimesAfterReschedule.desc: Recomputes targetStartTime and stagingCheckTime after a reschedule.

checkStagingAt10s.desc: Placement check: armed if placed, otherwise reschedule or end if no reschedules remain.

monitorCountdown.desc: Monitors false start and leaving the zone during the countdown.

finishCountdownImmediately.desc: Ends immediately (skipCountdowns): pacenotes, unfreeze, state finished, flow = true.

isOriginalSchedule.desc: True if no reschedule has taken place.

isFlowActive.desc: True if the state is finished or false_start.

isOngoing.desc: True if the countdown is running.

isWaiting.desc: True in the waiting states (staging check, armed, waiting_for_staged).

processWarnings.desc: Triggers the 60/30/15/10 s warnings (message and pacenotes).

getWallClockTime.desc: Simulated wall clock time (environment start + epoch, modulo 86400).

shouldDrawDebug.desc: True if data.drawDebug or the loop's stopZones flag is active.

drawDebugVisualization.desc: Draws the start plane and the debug markers.

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the countdown state in the node.

canSkipCountdown.desc: Indicates whether skipping the countdown is possible (waiting, vehicle placed with hysteresis, no debounce).

skipToCountdown.desc: Advances the loop clock to 6 s before the start.

onGameplayInteract.desc: Player interaction hook: requests a countdown skip if possible.

work.desc: Every frame: position, vehicle, proximity, start, state machine, skip, UI update (proximity/countdown hooks) and outputs.
